history.content: Which of b2, b4 and b6 is most important for n4 meeting its system requirement?

Which mathematical meaning of most important should I use?
Forced outage: P(F | do(B_i=0), H): system failure when bridge i is forced unusable; other bridges retain their scenario uncertainty.
Availability comparison: P(F | do(B_i=0), H) and P(F | do(B_i=1), H), reported separately for each bridge.
Diagnostic association: P(B_i=0 | F, H): bridge i is unusable given an observed system failure; this is not a causal effect.

questions: Use the availability comparison: report both forced-unusable and forced-usable failure probabilities for b2, b4 and b6 separately.
must_not: Use the diagnostic definition instead of the selected interventions
